==Description==
'''The Umbra''' is the narrator for the [[Totality Tower]] map. She is [[The Umbra]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].

==Appearance==
'''The Umbra''' had black skin. She wore a magenta chestplate and leggings, with yellow patterns on them. She had brown hair with ponytails. She had a purple crown with a headpiece which represents the sun on its back. She had glowing yellow eyes.

In her icons, she could hold a bow or two knives.
